title: Nexus #100 Space Opera 2 of 4 Rude Dude 2008 Mike Baron Steve Rude Landmark
conditionDescription: Bright, light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Nexus #100 (2008), Rude Dude Productions - landmark 100th issue! Nexus: Space Opera Act Two, part 2 of 4. Mike Baron and Steve Rude, painted Steve Rude cover. $4.99 cover price.

Back cover: Steve Rude: Artist in Motion (Flesk Publications) ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
